name: System clipboard text
notes: External plain text, including multi-line Unicode, pastes as an editable layer up to 100,000 characters; rich-text-only pasteboards paste their words. Styling from other apps is not kept. Focused-field system paste was not retested because smokes avoid the real clipboard. docs/NATIVE-CLIPBOARD.md

name: System clipboard images
notes: Mac: PNG, TIFF, JPEG, HEIC, WebP and GIF normalize to PNG, and Finder-copied image files paste their real pixels, not the icon. Only the first item or file is read; browser and Windows clipboards are out of scope.

name: Clipboard SVG markup
notes: Outgoing public.svg-image; incoming SVG representations, whole-document SVG plain text and Finder-copied SVG all reach the validated import review. Slide containers still refuse SVG paste.

name: Drag files from Finder
notes: Finder drops tested through WKWebView's real drag destination with a test NSDraggingInfo: images land under the pointer with one Undo, batches work, TIFF and HEIC convert to PNG. SVG, PDF and Sketch reach their reviews, and .oui opens in its own window through the shell (.fig shares that shell path but was not dropped in a smoke). Mixed drops are refused. Slides and the Files screen take no images. A person's physical drag was not exercised.

name: Drag assets to Finder
notes: The Export dialog preview drags as WebKit's own NSFilePromiseProvider, named by the shell, with no new message; the promise's real write produced the exported image. Canvas layers and Assets cannot be dragged. Finder's side of the drop was not exercised.

name: Quick Look previews
notes: Signed builds include a Quick Look preview and thumbnail extension for .oui. Both were proven in real system hosts, and invalid files fall back to the system view. Rendering is a simplification: effects, masks, blend modes, rich text runs, conic paints and shaders are not drawn, and text uses installed fonts. Finder's Space-bar panel and Intel were not exercised.

name: Spotlight document metadata
notes: A Spotlight importer in the app indexes title, description, page and layer names, fonts, page count and up to 256 KB of authored text on this Mac. Proven with mdimport and the live index through mdls and mdfind, with invalid files adding nothing. It needs the app installed in Applications.

name: macOS document versions
notes: Save stores the replaced bytes via NSFileVersion. File, Revert To lists versions, and Browse All Versions opens a sheet that previews each version from its own bytes and restores it as one Undo step. It is Forma's sheet rather than the NSDocument browser, its preview is simplified, and versions are recorded only on Save.

name: Reopen closed documents
notes: v0.2.0-dev.6: reachable workflow with appropriate core/browser/native checks and persistence/undo where applicable. See docs/VALIDATION-v0.2-grid-files-windows.md. Exact Figma reference acceptance remains separate. Native Reopen Closed Window restores the last closed window from its own local recovery identity. Availability depends on browser database retention. See docs/MAC-WINDOWS.md.

name: macOS print dialog
notes: Print presents the real macOS print sheet (PMPrintPanelView) and a real job produced PDF pages. Output is flattened 2× raster, so text is not vector.

name: Export through system share sheet
notes: Share opens the system picker with a private temporary file, and Share As chooses PNG, PDF or the Forma project. macOS proposes services. No service was carried through to delivery.

name: Accent color preferences
notes: Eight local accent presets plus the macOS accent color, sent by the shell and updated when it changes, adjusted to pass 4.5:1 in both themes. Stored outside .oui. Some older chrome and canvas selection overlays keep fixed violet values.

name: System appearance following
notes: Actual WKWebView and editor theme follow an appearance change while running, in both directions. Driven by NSApp.appearance, not by changing System Settings.

name: Reduced motion preference
notes: prefers-reduced-motion in WKWebView equals the macOS setting as it stood (off); the setting was not toggled. Earlier limits stand.

name: Increased contrast preference
notes: prefers-contrast in WKWebView equals the macOS setting as it stood (off); the setting was not toggled. Canvas selection keeps its own option.

name: VoiceOver integration
notes: Working basic path with limits; see docs/IMPLEMENTATION.md. Real AXUIElement reads confirm the window and controls from the shell, and failures now speak assertively. VoiceOver speech, rotor and page-level accessibility were not tested. Full reference behavior remains incomplete.

name: Keyboard focus ring
notes: Web focus ring as in UI-44-012, rendered by web content in the shell. Native Tab reachability under macOS keyboard settings is not verified.

name: App sandbox file access
notes: Not adopted. A sandboxed probe passed the basic smoke, save, export and drop, so the local server and clipboard work, but it failed the integration run. Save's sibling lock file, live context's sibling file, path-based window restoration and the move of existing local data into a container all remain unsolved.

notes: Unreleased source: Signed numerical offset distance controls real geometry and previews; positive/negative semantics and parent units are stated. This offsets paths rather than stroke width. docs/VECTOR-OFFSET.md. Native/exact-reference acceptance remains pending.

name: Offset square or round joins
notes: Offset now offers Miter (limit 4, bevel fallback), Round and a true clipped Square join, which cuts straight across at exactly the offset distance from the anchor on outer corners, in closed and open paths, with real preview, Apply and saved geometry. Curves are still flattened to 0.25 units and the existing geometry, topology and size limits apply. Exact Figma join equivalence remains unverified. docs/VECTOR-OFFSET.md. Square joins are also tested on curved closed and open paths; on flattened curves square and round differ by under 1% of area, and only real corners differ visibly.

name: Vector cut tool
notes: Scissors now also cut at existing anchors, and the Knife follows a freehand path, with Shift for straight. A drawn line that stops inside a shape runs on through it. No cuts on general vector networks.

name: Slice vectors into separate layers
notes: The Knife slices along a drawn path or closed loop into editable pieces in an identity-preserving group with one Undo. Gradient and image fills stay in place, strokes stay on each piece and effects stay on the group. Limits are 512 anchors and 32 pieces, independent edges and drawn stroke effects refuse, and vector networks are untested.

name: Vector eraser tool
notes: The fill eraser cuts true arcs, closes the layer box on what is left, keeps gradient and image fills in place, and erasing everything removes the layer in one Undo. Open unstroked fills and layers with effects now work. Flipped layers keep their box, and networks stay unsupported.

name: Brush preset picker
notes: Unreleased source: Reachable five stock presets and persistent local custom picker with actual rendered settings; built-ins are read-only and customization is independent. No Figma preset/library parity claim. docs/VECTOR-BRUSH-DRAWING.md.

name: Vector brush library
notes: Local library holds primitive, sampled, scatter and stretch presets with bounded JSON import and export. Hosted or shared libraries are absent.

name: Custom brush creation
notes: Named brushes can be primitive, sampled or stretch and persist locally. Multi-color art is absent.

name: Brush spacing
notes: Unreleased source: Spacing percent controls actual nominal-size arc-length intervals, including continuous remainder across input/coalesced segments and interpolated pressure at each stamp. Bounded strokes refuse atomically without a hidden prefix. docs/VECTOR-BRUSH-DRAWING.md.

name: Brush direction
notes: Unreleased source: Fixed or follow-stroke tangent direction plus angle control changes actual stamp transforms, including captured signed/nonuniform parent mapping. Native/reference acceptance pending. docs/VECTOR-BRUSH-DRAWING.md.

name: Brush size
notes: Unreleased source: Reachable size/aspect controls change editable stamp geometry and shared preview/export; captured settings, bounds and cancellation prevent stale gesture commits. docs/VECTOR-BRUSH-DRAWING.md.

name: Brush pressure response
notes: Supplied pen or touch pressure sets size and opacity response with a configurable minimum, and a mouse uses full pressure. Real Chromium pen input is tested; a physical tablet and pressure in the Mac app remain unverified.

name: Brush opacity
notes: Unreleased source: Opacity control changes each materialized stamp, preserving overlapping alpha compositing in shared Canvas/SVG/masks; pressure opacity can additionally vary stamps. Presets and completed artwork persist independently. docs/VECTOR-BRUSH-DRAWING.md.

name: Variable width strokes
notes: Curves and closed contours are native: handles stay on the document, and the band follows the cubic envelope with widths along real length. Miter joins, gradients and asymmetric width bias work; dashes do not. Older builds refuse curved or closed profiles and miter or gradient profiles, and ignore widthBias. docs/VARIABLE-WIDTH-STROKES.md.

name: Width control points
notes: Width points are added numerically or by clicking the stroke, by exact split, so the line does not move. Shift-drag or Anchor width bias % gives asymmetric widths. Width points are anchors, not a separate track.

name: Dynamic stroke wiggle
notes: The width wave now has a Smoothen control and repeatable irregular bumps, with a seamless closed seam, alongside exact splits. Effects, masks, instances and Motion are valid; live Booleans refuse and networks stay unsupported.

name: Dynamic stroke frequency
notes: Integer frequency 1–16 works on the same curved and closed geometry, with the same exact sampling. Undersized spacing and the 512-anchor budget refuse.

name: Stroke taper
notes: Taper presets gain amount, smooth and keep-existing options. Stamped brushes gain start and end taper by real stroke length, floored at 5% of size. Stretch brushes have no taper (refused).

name: Calligraphic stroke
notes: Nib sweeps curved and closed contours, and effects, masks, instances and Motion are valid. Pressure and tilt remain absent; auto layout and live Booleans refuse.

name: Text on path
notes: Closed baselines are native, and text passes the seam at any offset. 1–16 contours act as continuing baselines. Rich ranges and RTL work; effects, masks, instances and layer Motion are valid. Auto layout, live Booleans, Smart Animate, Bridge and SVG <textPath> import still refuse. Older builds refuse the new forms; earlier saved loops still open.

name: Text path offset
notes: Start offset has a numeric field and a canvas handle that drags along the real baseline with live glyph preview, Escape cancel and one Undo on release, and Flip text direction reverses the baseline. Exact Figma control equivalence is unverified. docs/TEXT-ON-PATH.md.

name: Shape builder tool
notes: Sources may now have different colors: a merged region takes the color of the topmost shape over the first region picked, and what remains keeps its colors. Fill-only networks are sources. Opaque unstroked sources are still required, and the very-fast-drag note stands.

name: Lasso vector selection
notes: Unreleased source: Actual freehand anchor lasso within one contour path; concave/self-crossing even-odd selection, inclusive boundaries, Shift add/Option subtract, signed-affine cached anchor projection, bounded outline and invalidatable pointer/context guards. Selection-only operation leaves document/history untouched; up to256 vertices/10000 anchors. docs/VECTOR-ERASER-LASSO.md. Exact Figma reference/native acceptance remains pending.

name: Multi-vector editing
notes: Multi-vector anchor drags snap to geometry outside the moving contours, though handles do not. Shared networks, cross-layer topology and anchor-fragment Cut remain absent.

name: Pattern fills
notes: Editable local pattern tile source with up to 64 bounded primitives, staged Apply with one Undo, shared SVG rendering and local persistence. Arbitrary live document-layer pattern sources remain absent.

name: Pattern scale
notes: Unreleased source: Reachable surface scale percentage controls repeat editable patterns/noise/local textures at1–6400%, bounded by0.25–65536px tile periods. Shared canvas/SVG/export/masks/styles/component/clipboard validation, no-op preservation, Undo/reopen. docs/PATTERN-TEXTURE-NOISE-FILLS.md. Exact Figma reference/native acceptance remains pending.

name: Pattern rotation
notes: Unreleased source: Surface rotation changes the complete gap-free repeating lattice around its source origin with bounded angle, shared SVG/canvas/export coordinates, opacity/mask/affine tests, Undo and saved reopening. docs/PATTERN-TEXTURE-NOISE-FILLS.md. Exact Figma reference/native acceptance remains pending.

name: Repeat pattern offsets
notes: Unreleased source: Repeat X/Y offsets translate the complete surface lattice without tile gaps, retaining rotation/scale and shared canvas/export/mask coordinates; explicit reset, Undo and persistence. docs/PATTERN-TEXTURE-NOISE-FILLS.md. Exact Figma reference/native acceptance remains pending.

name: Noise fill
notes: Unreleased source: Seeded deterministic raster noise fill with monochrome/two-color or independent RGB channels, coverage/transparent pixels, tile size/grain scale, colors and seed controls; pure lossless PNG snapshot generation, validated canonical metadata and Undo/save. This is bounded repeating raster grain, not a shader. docs/PATTERN-TEXTURE-NOISE-FILLS.md. Exact Figma reference/native acceptance remains pending.

name: Texture fill
notes: Unreleased source: Embedded still PNG/JPEG/WebP texture fill chooser/replacement, intrinsic pixel tiling, scale/rotation/phase/opacity and image adjustments. Existing decoder/signature/dimension/byte limits, delayed-file context guards, no external URLs, Undo/save/PNG/SVG preservation. Source-MCP image-asset upload remains separate. docs/PATTERN-TEXTURE-NOISE-FILLS.md. Exact Figma reference/native acceptance remains pending.

name: Progressive blur
notes: A real spatially varying nine-level blur with start and end radii and direction across shared rendering and exports, within strict budgets. Exact continuous effect and interchange parity are absent.

name: Brush import
notes: Forma brush JSON imports validate before use, including the stretch field. Third-party brush formats are unsupported.

name: Brush export
notes: Selected-brush and whole-library JSON export includes stretch settings. No third-party format.

name: Brush reset
notes: Unreleased source: Reset restores the selected saved stock/custom preset without changing completed document artwork; source settings and custom presets persist locally. Document Undo is reserved for materialized strokes. docs/VECTOR-BRUSH-DRAWING.md.

name: Illustration mode toolbar
notes: Draw mode adds a Brush presets menu and an Illustration tools menu reaching Edit points, Bend, Cut, Erase, Lasso, Knife, Shape builder, Offset, Outline stroke, Separate regions and Linear/Radial repeat, with toolbar keyboard support and on-screen checks at 1100, 900 and 760 px. View state only, no separate Draw inspector, and the entries are not registered commands, so they are absent from Actions search. docs/STRETCH-BRUSHES.md.

name: Radial repeat
notes: Keep live stores one layer whose copies follow its edits and Motion, with export bounds, editable count, pivot, angle and rotation, Expand to layers and Remove. Copies are not individually editable until expanded. Not allowed as a mask, Boolean or instance child, directly in auto layout, or nested; limit 4,096 copies per page. Bridge refuses; an older build shows only the source.

name: Linear repeat
notes: Same live repeat with count and X/Y steps, under the same limits.

name: Stretch brush creation
notes: Sampled vector brushes can stretch one silhouette along the whole stroke as one ordinary editable path, with holes kept, pressure on thickness only, one Undo, save and export. Art is warped by bounded cubic approximation, tight turns can fold a thick band, and there is no tiling or fixed end caps. Preset JSON gains an optional stretch field; .oui is unchanged. docs/STRETCH-BRUSHES.md.

name: Scatter brush creation

name: Backdrop filter clipping
notes: The same target clip applies to nested targets in frame-local coordinates at any depth. General backdrop roots remain unsupported.

name: Shader effect assignment
notes: Overlay, Displace and Sample layer modes run through the stack. Sample layer feeds the layer, without its effects, at up to 1024 px, to GLSL through f_source(uv) and replaces the layer at that point; Pixelate and Channel Split are bundled. Sampling passes through in the exported player and shows an empty texture in the inspector preview. Static exports warn if a sample was not ready. Older builds refuse these files.

name: Shader effect parameter controls
notes: Parameters plus mode, blend, opacity and displacement, pixel-tested.

name: Shader effect stacking
notes: Effects chain and reorder in the stack, and a browser pixel test proves a shader and blur order change output. Note that test reverses order through a store edit, not the UI; persistence was already covered.

name: Shader texture clipping to layer
notes: Clip to layer uses layer alpha; turning it off draws the full box with an optional outset. Pixel-tested on an ellipse.

name: Shader version update indicator
notes: Layers stay pinned to their version until Update shader is pressed, with an indicator for bundled and file shaders. Superseded source is retained, so pinned pixels don't change.

name: Baseline alignment
notes: First-line baselines carry through nested, rotated, flipped and scaled containers into the row's axes. They use the app's own text measurement, so native font-metric equivalence is a reference question.

name: Stroke included in layout
notes: Stroke inclusion covers linear, grid, gap, padding, fill and wrap, transformed children, arrowheads, and now miter tips on polygons, stars, paths and lines up to the miter limit. Tips add one even outset on all sides, vector networks are not measured, and shadows are excluded.

name: Nested instance override
notes: A selected nested instance edits its own properties, variants and swap for that outer instance only, at any depth. Generated IDs and overrides stay stable across later syncs, with Undo, reopen, cross-file copy and export tested. Slot-bearing components refuse; Figma Bridge transfer of nested overrides is not validated.

name: Preserve overrides when swapping
notes: Property values follow name and type. Layer overrides follow component key or path, then same type and name with repeated names paired in order, and on a swap the only unmatched layer of its type on each side. Overrides a swap cannot carry are remembered per main and return on a swap back, including through a chain, bounded to 8 mains and 200 layers each. Reset forgets them. Swaps through an exposed instance-swap property do not use this memory.

name: Interactive variant transitions
notes: Partial: reusable receiving-instance variant actions, nested materialized ownership, separate reaction binding, hover/press restoration, transient deterministic/collision-safe IDs, Undo/save/library closure and bounded presentation. Full trigger precedence/merging, arbitrary ancestor targets, nested self-scroll and native Bridge transfer remain unsupported. See docs/INTERACTIVE-VARIANT-TRANSITIONS.md. Variant actions work inside customized slots.

name: Variant matching on swap
notes: A variant change picks the exact match, else the first variant with that value, and carries property values by name and type.

name: Component slot definition
notes: Slots can list up to 32 preferred components and can require them, which applies through the slot controls but not to pasted content. Slot-bearing mains stay outside other components and instances, and nested template inheritance remains absent.

name: Editable instance slot content
notes: Customized slots accept slot-bearing instances of other mains, with their own slots, Undo, save and copy. Preferred components list first and a slot can require them. Main defaults, managed layers and self nesting refuse. Bounded islands remain. Older builds refuse these files.

name: Reset instance slot content
notes: Reset removes nested slot content, including nested slot-bearing instances, in one Undo. No native slot round trip.

name: Enable library in file
notes: Local snapshot libraries enable per file with stable IDs, Undo and persistence, up to eight libraries.

name: Disable library in file
notes: Disabled definitions leave the Assets component browser with a hidden count, and their styles, variables and guide styles leave the inspector pickers. A layer already using one keeps it and still shows it, and instances stay linked.

name: Browse available libraries
notes: Adds search across cached libraries. No hosted or community discovery.

name: Search library assets
notes: Unreleased source: Reachable case-insensitive local snapshot asset search and24-row accessible pagination filter named component/set/style/guide/token groups. docs/LOCAL-COMPONENT-LIBRARIES.md.

name: Library asset preview
notes: Set previews now show any variant. The 256-layer, geometry and SVG budgets and font-metric limits remain.

name: Library update notification
notes: A newer imported snapshot triggers an update notice, with ignore handling and per-asset accepted versions.

name: Review library updates
notes: Adds named variable and mode review with up to 200 changed values, 24 shown, and in-use removed or retyped variables can be mapped from the review. No unrestricted visual diff or merge.

name: Accept all library updates
notes: Removed or retyped variables in use can be mapped to an incoming variable of the same type, which retargets layers, aliases, form inputs and prototype actions, or detached with their values kept. All apply in one Undo. Prototype expressions that name a variable in text are not rewritten.

name: Accept selected library updates
notes: Same variable decisions apply to selected updates, with the dependency closure, and component conflicts can be replaced explicitly. Prototype expressions that name a variable in text are not rewritten. Nothing is hosted.

name: Ignore library update
notes: Unreleased source: Reachable Ignore suppresses a specific immutable local snapshot notification while preserving manual review and cached consumers; saved bounded ignore history supports Undo. docs/LOCAL-COMPONENT-LIBRARIES.md.

name: Deprecate library component
notes: A component, a whole variant set or one variant can be deprecated with a reason. A variant's status publishes with its set, counts in the fingerprint, and shows in component search and usage rows.

name: Library analytics
notes: An explicit scan counts current references in the local project library plus the open file: files, versions, instances, layers and unused assets, up to 2,000 files. It cannot see other people or devices, .oui files never opened here, history or trends, Trash or branch copies, and the panel says so.

name: Library usage counts
notes: Now also counted across device files and for styles, variables and guides, on top of current-file instance counts. No organization, cloud or longitudinal data.

name: Library permissions
notes: Retired October 31, 2026: Forma is an offline Mac app, so shared library permissions are out of scope.

name: Organization library approval
notes: Retired October 31, 2026: Forma is an offline Mac app, so organization approval is out of scope.

name: Move component between libraries
notes: Consumer-side repair: after a source removal is accepted, a group is re-homed to a cached library with the same topology. Local IDs, instances and overrides are kept in one Undo, and the next review offers the new definition. Sources are not edited. Refuses edited definitions, an already installed target, topology mismatch and changed slot identities.

name: Swap library source
notes: Reviewed local source replacement with atomic refusals for unsafe mappings.

name: Missing library indicator
notes: Missing snapshots and removed groups are shown while cached artwork stays usable.

name: Smart animate transition
notes: Rectangles, ellipses, polygons, stars and paths morph, including different contour counts and open against closed shapes. Outlines over 1,024 curves cross-fade. Strokes and effects interpolate when they pair and fade when they do not. Rich text with the same words animates size, spacing and color per run. Vector networks, text on a path, dynamic and calligraphic strokes and progressive blur still refuse Smart animate.

name: Prototype password
notes: Real AES-256-GCM encryption with a PBKDF2 key at 600,000 iterations. Anyone with the file and password has the content, weak passwords can be guessed offline, a password cannot be recovered or revoked, and files open only from https or locally.

name: Prototype audio playback
notes: Local MP3, AAC, WAV, AIFF, FLAC or Ogg up to 60 seconds, saved in the file as WAV. Plays from presenter controls, on arrival at a frame, or from Play sound and Stop sound actions that run across frames, and sounds overlap. Motion and transition sync are absent, slide embeds skip these actions, and playback was measured through the audio graph, not confirmed audibly in the native app.

name: Prototype video playback
notes: Embedded MP4 and WebM playback in prototypes with transforms, clips, loop, mute, start time and a new non-destructive end time. Nonrectangular clips and masks require manual Play, codec and autoplay policies apply, and remote media and real transcoding are absent.

notes: Working preview path; validated by core/browser tests or native smoke. Exact reference parity still needs per-feature audit.

name: Comment link
notes: Local thread links work, and replies now have their own links that open the right reply page and focus that reply. An OS link handler and opening another file from a pasted link are absent, because that needs wider native permissions.

name: Emoji reaction
notes: Eight quick reactions plus search across the whole local emoji catalog with skin tones, up to 24 different reactions on a message. Older builds refuse a file carrying an emoji outside the original eight.

name: Copy comment text
notes: Copy root/reply plain text from the local thread panel; browser clipboard refusal exposes a selected read-only text fallback for standard Command-C. No fabricated native node/SVG clipboard representation or expanded IPC. See docs/LOCAL-COMMENT-THREADS.md.

name: Comment on prototype
notes: Threads are ordinary comments with optional surface:'prototype': reply, resolve, delete, filter, link. Pins scroll with frame content; threads left in Design on the frame or its layers also appear. Lists 200 threads per frame. Older builds open these files. docs/PROTOTYPE-COMMENTS.md.

name: Comment permissions
notes: Retired October 31, 2026: Forma is an offline Mac app, so shared comment permissions are out of scope.

name: Annotation tool
notes: Annotate on canvas opens the editor at the clicked point; Measure on canvas takes two clicks with snapping to box points. Both also reach View and Actions, with Undo and persistence. Keyboard users have percentage fields in the sidebar.

name: Annotation text
notes: Inspect → Layer annotations creates/edits/removes literal plain-text notes with Undo/save/reopen, original-context guards, locks and component defaults/root overrides. Private metadata is excluded from artwork, library and explicit Figma delivery. See docs/LOCAL-LAYER-ANNOTATIONS.md.

name: Annotation category
notes: Notes pick a category from their layer or from any category in the file, which copies it to the layer. A category exists while a layer uses it. Older builds refuse files using the new annotation fields.

name: Annotation categories management
notes: File-wide rename, recolor, merge and delete in one Undo, reporting locked or inherited layers left unchanged. Empty file-level categories do not exist.

name: Annotated property reference
notes: Twenty-one live properties, adding fill, stroke, radius, type, blend, layout and prototype target. Stacks summarize as a count; mismatched types read as unavailable.

name: Measurement annotation
notes: Box width, height and diagonal, any two box points (optionally along one page axis), and painted width and height. Painted bounds use visualBounds, so they are conservative.

name: Distance annotation
notes: Box centers, centers along an axis, nearest box edge gap or overlap, or two chosen points. All live; a missing target reads as unavailable. Edge gaps use transformed boxes, not contours.

name: Developer note
notes: Inspect creates and edits file-local developer notes, filters them and displays them in cross-page handoff annotations. Validation, context guards, Undo/persistence and component root override semantics apply; no hosted developer assignment. See docs/LOCAL-LAYER-ANNOTATIONS.md.

name: Annotation visibility

name: Recover after crash
notes: Bounded write-ahead journal plus transactional recovery. A real renderer kill before autosave restores pending edits as one Undo step; stale or invalid journals are discarded. Edits inside the ~60 ms throttle, patches over 2 MB and OS/machine failure can still lose work. See docs/RECOVERY-RELIABILITY.md.

name: Preview older version

name: Duplicate version as new file
notes: A reviewed named version duplicates into an independent local file in All files without replacing the current design. Full validation, original-context checks and abortable repository writes prevent stale actions. Scoped internal references stay intact. See docs/LOCAL-VERSION-REVIEW.md.

name: Version link
notes: Local version links work, including from outside the app through the registered forma-version scheme. An open project comes forward, otherwise recent files are checked for that project. Links are local to this Mac and do not carry the saved version.

name: Compare versions
notes: Named local version → Compare with current design matches stable page/layer IDs, reports additions/removals/changes/cross-page moves and layer order changes. Object key order/timestamps do not create changes. Structural comparison only; no pixel diff or author attribution. See docs/LOCAL-VERSION-REVIEW.md.

name: Version change summary
notes: Version comparison summarizes complete layer/page/document changes and named fields, with 200 bounded entries and explicit count/budget diagnostics. Report omits property values, comment bodies, URLs and image/font bytes. See docs/LOCAL-VERSION-REVIEW.md.

name: Branch creation
notes: File → Branches forks atomically (main, base snapshot, working copy, registry) with a name check, 50 per file, no nesting. Local only; branches are not stored in .oui. See docs/LOCAL-BRANCHES.md.

name: Branch review
notes: Conflicts plus structural base→branch and base→main summaries with previews; "Mark as reviewed" stamps the exact branch revision with the local profile label. Single-user: no other reviewers, comments on the review or pixel diff.

name: Branch merge
notes: Pure headless three-way merge by page and layer identity, run from main, one Undo step, full validation before commit. Text does not merge within a string; no update-branch-from-main; dangling prototype links stay as they do on delete.

name: Branch conflict resolution
notes: Per-conflict main/branch choice for layer properties, delete vs edit, moves, cycles, stacking, pages, keyed library items and deleted component/variable/style references. Merge stays blocked until all are answered; resolutions are not persisted across dialog closes.

name: Branch archive
notes: Archive refuses edits, Restore reopens, and only archived branches delete from the device. Permanent deletion of main cascades to branches, bases and persisted Undo.

name: Branch status
notes: Real ahead, behind, diverged, conflict, merged and archived states from content comparison, with a top-bar indicator and native window title. Status reads each branch, so very large files are slow to fill.

name: Main branch protection
notes: Per-file toggle refuses direct edits to main and requires a review of the current branch revision to merge. Self-imposed, no permissions; Undo/Redo stay available; MCP and direct .oui writes are outside the guard.

name: Edit history persistence
notes: Undo/Redo persist as layer patches in the same transaction as recovery. Limits: 60 steps, 12 MB total, 6 MB per step, 40 ms encoding per save; a stale or damaged record is ignored and over-quota history is dropped so the document still saves. In-memory Undo remains 100 steps; an explicit file open starts fresh.

name: File corruption recovery
notes: A stored file failing validation opens recovery choices from startup, Home or Storage: newest version as a copy, reported repaired copy, raw download; the record is never changed. Does not repair an IndexedDB database that cannot open.

name: Storage quota notification
notes: File → Storage and recovery shows quota, durability and measured sizes; once-per-level notices at 80% and 95%; a specific "storage is full" message on failed writes; explicit durable storage request. Validated with simulated quota values and errors.

name: Sketch document import

name: PDF document import
notes: PDF import is unchanged. Patterns, mesh gradients, soft masks and image masks keep the page as an image, and it is tested with synthetic PDFs only.

name: Clipboard paste from Figma
notes: On Mac, Paste reads a base64 fig-kiwi payload from the clipboard's HTML through the .fig worker with Cancel, validation and one Undo. It is tested only with self-authored payloads in a publicly researched shape, and no real clipboard capture has been decoded. Image bytes are not expected, so images stay placeholders.

name: Clipboard copy to Figma
notes: Copy selection as SVG places SVG markup on the clipboard as text and as an SVG flavor. Whether another app accepts that paste is untested, and Forma writes no fig-kiwi clipboard payload.

name: Figma REST JSON import
notes: Local REST JSON import keeps components, variants, auto layout, styles and prototypes live. Text, Boolean and instance-swap properties are now live, and library mains are rebuilt from their first instance on an Imported components page, so a rebuilt main shows that instance's overrides as defaults. Image bytes and variables are absent from the input. Tested with self-authored responses only.

name: Plugin iframe UI
notes: ui HTML up to 100 KB in an opaque frame; scripts run in a terminable worker and cannot freeze the editor. The mirrored DOM now has MutationObserver and viewport IntersectionObserver. Limits: geometry lags a frame, preventDefault applies from the next event, no DOMParser, custom elements or Shadow DOM. Dialog-bound.

name: Plugin parameter input
notes: Strict typed inputs through trusted host controls with a copied snapshot. Fields can list this file's pages, layers, components, styles or variables, passing only the chosen ID, and can show or hide on an earlier field. Package code cannot compute suggestions while the form is open.

name: Plugin message bridge
notes: Carries async requests, reviewed commits and bounded interface messages, with source-window checks and budgets. Malformed or flooded traffic ends the run.

name: Plugin document read API
notes: Reads add fills, radius, typography, child IDs, a parentId filter, image and export reads, and with assets:read this file's styles, variables, collections and components plus each layer's assignments. Comments, annotations, code source and style values stay excluded.

name: Plugin document write API
notes: Up to 20 reviewed forma.commit proposals per run, each one Undo step, plus a final propose. Adds delete, reparent and effects, with subtree ownership checks shown in review. Component properties, variants, slots, shader effects and geometry updates on rich or controlled layers stay out of reach.

name: Plugin node creation
notes: Creates rectangle, ellipse, text, image, frame, group, section, component, instance, vector, line, polygon and star, nested with parent-relative coordinates, and masks at creation. Instances take name, position, visibility and opacity only. No slots or code layers.

name: Plugin selection API
notes: Selection read with child IDs and fills, plus reviewed delivery, mid-run through commit. The dialog is modal, so there is no selection-change event.

name: Plugin font loading
notes: fonts:read lists and loads bundled, embedded and registered families, and only loaded families can enter a proposal. Loading never downloads.

name: Plugin image API
notes: image:write takes PNG, JPEG, GIF and WebP up to 2 MB after decode, as layers or image fills shown in review. image:read returns one layer up to 4 MB. No SVG input or video.

name: Plugin export API
notes: export:read renders one layer to SVG, PNG, JPG or PDF up to 4 MB, scale 0.1–4 (0.25–4 for PDF), and exportNodes takes 1–24 layers up to 2.8 MB in total.

name: Plugin storage
notes: storage:local get/set/delete/keys in a separate per-plugin IndexedDB record (200 keys, 256 KB), persisting across runs and reload, isolated per plugin, never in .oui, cleared on Remove. Native WKWebView not exercised.

name: Plugin networking permissions
notes: No network by default. Requires manifest allowedOrigins (exact https or loopback origins), reviewed display and a per-run network:fetch grant, enforced in the host and again by a separate frame that narrows its own connect-src; tests show zero requests to unlisted origins. Target must allow Origin: null; text responses to 1 MB; 25 requests per run; tested against loopback servers only.

name: Plugin error isolation
notes: Worker, bridge and interface failures, including hangs, remove owned frames with no proposal applied. Not an OS or memory boundary.

name: Plugin cancellation
notes: Cancel, invalidation, deadline and watchdog remove interface and network frames. Stopping a spinning script verified in real WKWebView.

name: Plugin development manifest
notes: Closed manifest with optional ui, network, codegen and 11 permissions, each section paired with its permission.

name: Plugin reload
notes: Reload installed local catalog or replace a reviewed package; explicit rerun creates a fresh worker and invalidates old grants/handlers. No automatic code/file watching or external development runtime. See docs/LOCAL-COMMAND-PLUGINS.md.

name: Plugin console
notes: Bounded console for plugin logs, interface console output and errors, and each network request.

name: Widget insertion
notes: Import, review, install and insert from the manager, whiteboard toolbar or Actions. Install never runs code.

name: Widget state synchronization
notes: Validated JSON (32 KB) on the frame, in step with its layers through Undo, duplicate and save. Stale results are refused.

name: Widget resizing
notes: Canvas handles and size fields resize within package limits, and host layout regenerates the layers from the saved view. Code runs once with a resize event after a resize settles, not on each drag step or after Undo. Text layout is estimated.

name: Widget interaction
notes: Host hit targets send an action name to a fresh worker, one Undo step per event, with host-owned text input. Targets follow a rotated widget, and buttons can declare a host hover tint. No hover events in code and no timers, because every update is an Undo step.

name: Widget property menu
notes: Host panel with action, toggle, choice, color and separator items (at most 12), plus refresh, console and convert to layers.

name: Widget permissions
notes: selection:read and page:read, granted per package, session-only and revocable. Widgets change only their own layers.

notes: Accessible searchable hierarchy outline with cross-page keyboard navigation, inherited states, 100-row rendering and read-only selection. Native VoiceOver acceptance pending. See docs/DOCUMENT-ACCESSIBILITY.md.

name: Keyboard-only layer creation
notes: Guarded keyboard insertion dialog for eleven layer types, including paths typed as points, with bounded geometry, Undo and save. Freehand, media and workspace-specific objects remain unfinished. See docs/DOCUMENT-ACCESSIBILITY.md.

name: Keyboard-only selection
notes: Keyboard outline navigation/selection complements Layers and canvas parent/child/sibling paths, cross-page selection and hidden/locked inspection without mutation. See docs/DOCUMENT-ACCESSIBILITY.md.

name: Keyboard-only transform
notes: Keyboard numerical move/resize/rotation fields and canvas nudge paths validated with Undo/save and inherited-lock refusal. See docs/DOCUMENT-ACCESSIBILITY.md.

name: Keyboard-only property editing
notes: Keyboard-only edits of position, size (with arithmetic), hex fill and the color slider are validated with Undo. Canvas-only gestures such as gradient handles have not been audited for numeric equivalents on every property.

name: Keyboard-only export
notes: Export shortcut, Tab and Enter produce a real browser download. The native save panel is not validated.

name: Visible focus indicators
notes: One token gives a 2px ring (3px in Increased contrast) at 3:1 or better in both themes, checked at every Tab stop in the chrome and 36 dialog states. Text fields now get an outline, not only a 1px border change.

name: Logical focus order
notes: Tab order is header, menu bar, layers, canvas; F6 leaves the canvas, where Tab selects siblings, then toolbar and properties. Each layer row's lock and hide buttons remain separate Tab stops, so long documents have long sidebars.

name: Focus trapping in dialogs
notes: One app-wide manager gives every aria-modal dialog initial focus, Tab containment, stray-focus return and opener return, guarded by document id. Validated across 36 dialog states.

name: Escape closes dialogs
notes: Escape closed all 36 dialog states tested, and all 29 modal components now handle it. I added the missing handler to PrototypeRenderBoundary.

name: Contrast compliant controls
notes: Text, accent and focus tokens pass 4.5:1 and 3:1 in both themes. Rendered text passes in the editor, menus, Home, 25 dialogs and while hovering menu items and toolbar buttons. Two failures found this way were fixed. Control boundaries meet 3:1 only in Increased contrast.

name: Larger UI scaling
notes: Interface scale reaches 150% with persisted presets, scoped chrome layout and canvas-coordinate correction. A real click at 150% selects the right layer in the shipped shell. Artwork, presentation and export scale stay separate; no unrestricted OS text sizing or complete assistive-technology acceptance. See docs/PREFERENCES.md and UI-45-004.

name: Reduced motion mode
notes: Partial: existing Follow system / Reduce / Allow interface-motion setting persists locally, responds to OS/storage changes and scopes chrome effects/scrolling. Editor Motion pauses when reduction activates; explicit Play remains authored preview without loop. Prototype/Slides system/file playback rules and exports remain separate. See docs/INTERFACE-MOTION.md and UI-02-023. Broader/native/reference acceptance pending.

name: Color-independent selection indicators
notes: Active tools, layer rows, pages, open menus, tabs and pressed toggles change shape as well as color, with aria-pressed or aria-current, validated by computed-style comparison. Canvas selection keeps its outlines and handles.

name: High-contrast selection
notes: Partial: persistent local black/white layer/hover/box selection outlines, resize/rotation handles and vector anchor activity on Design/Whiteboard canvas; screen-space SVG pixel, keyboard, persistence and no-artwork-mutation checks. Specialized editing overlays, Slides/presentation and a system-wide contrast theme remain outside this option. See docs/SELECTION-CONTRAST.md.

name: Accessible tooltips
notes: Titled controls show a role=tooltip on keyboard focus, linked by aria-describedby; Escape dismisses it without moving focus. Pointer hover still uses the native title tooltip, and touch has no equivalent.

name: Accessible error announcements
notes: notifyError and any toast worded as a failure speak once through one assertive live region, and inline errors already use role=alert. Toasts have no type, so failure is recognized from wording, checked against the failure toasts in the app today.

name: Accessible comment threads
notes: Canvas pins have keyboard activation and original-source proofs; thread dialog supports focus trap/return, focused-thread headings, labeled filters/forms, pagination, readable authors/times, errors/status and plain-copy fallback at 125% UI scale. Native assistive-technology/reference acceptance pending. See docs/LOCAL-COMMENT-THREADS.md.

name: Template gallery
notes: Home and Resources/Actions expose a searchable category gallery of six original free Design, Whiteboard and Presentation templates plus bounded personal local kits. No third-party template marketplace claim. See docs/LOCAL-TEMPLATE-GALLERY.md.

name: Template preview
notes: Selected-template page previews render isolated saved base artwork without changing the current design or registering template fonts. Existing 500-layer/4 MB font-safe preview limits and explicit diagnostics apply. See docs/LOCAL-TEMPLATE-GALLERY.md.

name: Template insertion
notes: One selected page inserts editable artwork and supported remapped dependencies at the matching Design/Whiteboard page root with one Undo and real save/reopen. Comments/page settings/Motion omissions are reported; presentations create new decks instead of unregistered frame insertion. See docs/LOCAL-TEMPLATE-GALLERY.md.

name: UI kit browsing
notes: Resources → UI kits, illustrations and tutorials… browses two original offline kits of real main components, openable as new files or insertable in one Undo. No community or online catalog is implied. See docs/RESOURCE-LIBRARY.md.

name: Icon library browsing
notes: Resources/Actions opens a licensed offline catalog of 1,951 Lucide icons with multiword search, pagination, selected preview and license display. Validated configurable size/color/stroke/position insertion creates ordinary editable vectors with one Undo and oui save/reopen in Design/Whiteboard. This is local library browsing, without an external community marketplace or slide insertion. See docs/LOCAL-ICON-LIBRARY.md.

name: Illustration library browsing
notes: Eight original vector illustrations, searchable with previews, insert as editable vectors in one Undo. The set is small and fixed.

name: Education resources
notes: Fourteen original offline guides, readable in the app, some linking to a tutorial, covering hierarchy, spacing, color, prototyping, components, accessibility, typography, auto layout, variables, responsive frames, handoff, motion, interface writing and design systems. English only, as the interface is.

name: Tutorial files
notes: Three original tutorials open as real .oui files with working prototype interactions, variables, conditions and variant changes, exercised headless and with one tutorial played in the browser. Steps are not tracked or checked. English only.

name: In-app onboarding
notes: Adds the first-run offer to existing opt-in guidance, and Getting started now links to guides and practice files. The tour stays optional and six steps long. Other limits unchanged.

name: First-run canvas tour
notes: Empty library gets an inline menu-bar offer once, with a persisted receipt. It does not auto-start, take focus or cover the canvas. Existing libraries are never offered it. Hidden below 1000 px, and clearing storage with no projects re-offers it.

name: Tool contextual help
notes: Contextual help covers all 18 toolbar tools and 8 areas: Prototype mode, Dev Mode, components, auto layout, variables, libraries, plugins and export. The help button opens the area for the current mode, shows live personalized command bindings and activates nothing. See docs/EDITOR-LEARNING.md.

name: Help center links
notes: Fixed trusted links open existing Forma guide, product and privacy pages through normal browser links with no project identifiers. Link destinations and real UI paths are validated; the guide is explicitly a preview that may lag source. Native/reference verification remains separate. See docs/EDITOR-LEARNING.md.

name: Release notes panel
notes: v0.2.0-dev.9: Help/Actions opens bounded bundled release history, app-version marker, source/preview distinction, scope notes and validated public preview download/checksum. Development entries have no installer link; error/Retry/focus and unchanged selection/tool/project/history tested. Snapshot history, not live update discovery/native updater. docs/RELEASE-NOTES.md.

name: Create site project
notes: File → New site and a Home starter create a .oui with workspace:'site'. Mac uses the existing open-document path, so no native IPC changed. Site data is additive and validated on load and on every edit.

name: Site page tree
notes: Page tree with add, child, duplicate, delete, reorder, nest and unnest through Undo. Slugs set output folders, are validated per level, and the home page writes at the site root.

name: Site navigation links
notes: Per-layer links to a page, web address, section or collection item, as real <a> elements with relative paths and aria-current. The Navigation block inserts links once and does not update when pages change.

name: Responsive breakpoint editor
notes: Settings adds up to 4 custom breakpoints, and each breakpoint is a real editable frame beside Desktop. Dragging a frame's side changes its width, and invalid widths are restored.

name: Desktop breakpoint
notes: Desktop is the page design width and resizes page roots, and the canvas edits it directly.

name: Tablet breakpoint
notes: Tablet shows as a real canvas frame with auto layout and constraints. Edits become Tablet overrides, one Undo step each; Desktop is untouched.

name: Mobile breakpoint
notes: Mobile works as Tablet and inherits every wider breakpoint. Deleting a layer on the frame hides it there, and new layers join the Desktop tree.

name: Breakpoint property overrides
notes: Text, strokes, effects and gradient fills now vary per breakpoint, with the existing typed properties. Differing text ships each version and CSS shows one. Reordering and renames on a frame are not kept.

name: Responsive stack
notes: Auto layout maps to flexbox with direction, gap, padding, sizing and wrap per breakpoint. Includes a Stack block and Stack on mobile. Desktop geometry was checked against the solver. First-on-top stacking order is not exported.

name: Responsive grid
notes: Grid maps to CSS grid with per-breakpoint columns. Explicit placements come from placeGrid, and the Grid block defaults to 3/2/1 columns. fr tracks ignore a maximum size.

name: Site interactions
notes: Each layer can run up to 8 ordered click steps: toggle, show, hide, scroll to, move focus or copy text. Any step can wait on whether another layer is showing, with keyboard support. A step aimed at a layer inside a repeated list has no effect, and no visitor code runs.

name: Hover effects
notes: Hover scale, opacity, move, fill and text color with duration, also applied on keyboard focus. Runs in the exported site.

name: Scroll effects
notes: Fade, slide-up and zoom reveals, parallax, and keyframed scroll timelines with start and end. Reduced motion respected. Motion does not vary per breakpoint.

name: Site animations
notes: Five presets or custom keyframes (up to 16, opacity, position, scale, rotation) with duration, delay, loop and easing, exported as CSS @keyframes.

name: CMS collection
notes: Local collections saved in the project, with seven validated field types. Limits are 50 collections, 50 fields and 2,000 items each.

name: CMS item editor
notes: Item editor with typed inputs, slug, draft state, reorder, duplicate and delete through Undo. Image values are decoded before acceptance. No bulk or CSV import.

name: CMS binding
notes: Lists with limit, sort and up to 16 filters, and text, image and rich text bindings with one page per item. Reference fields link collections by item, bindings and item links can follow a reference, and a list can show items that refer to the current page's item. A draft referenced item counts as empty, and each reference field points to one item.

name: Published preview
notes: In-app preview of the export output at each breakpoint in an opaque, CSP-pinned sandbox, with page navigation. Embeds show a note and forms never send.

notes: Retired October 31, 2026: Forma is an offline Mac app, so hosted staging is out of scope; Sites export static files.

name: Create branded asset project

name: Brand template gallery
notes: Search and category filter over project templates, plus a starter with six published templates in five categories. Other projects get templates through a package file.

name: Template locking
notes: The store and MCP refuse changes to locked layers, including paste, reorder, grouping and delete; published template frames are frozen until unpublished. Files edited outside Forma are flagged by lock digest, not refused, and pasted copies of an asset become plain layers.

name: Editable content slots
notes: Text slots allow content only, with optional brand color, brand font and character limit, enforced on panel, canvas and MCP paths. Slots freeze while In review or Approved.

name: Editable image slots
notes: Image slots accept replacement embedded PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF images through the panel and refuse a change to a different fill type. Replacing resets the crop.

name: Brand color constraints
notes: Refuse or Flag mode covers fills, strokes, gradient stops, shadows and text range colors on the Assets page, with a Publish gate on templates. Draft templates are flagged only; image pixels and other pages are not checked.

name: Brand font constraints
notes: Refuse or Flag mode matches font family names on the Assets page, including text ranges, with a Publish gate. Names only; fallback fonts are not checked and no font files are bundled.

name: Bulk text replacement
notes: Literal find and replace, or set a slot, across checked or all assets as one Undo step. Frozen and over-length results are skipped and reported.

name: Bulk image replacement
notes: One image for all targets, or exactly one per editable target in list order, as one Undo step. Frozen assets are skipped; a change past the 50 MB project limit is refused.

name: Asset spreadsheet input
notes: Strict CSV and TSV by paste or file, up to 5 MB, 500 rows and 64 columns, with a column mapping and per-row review before any write. No .xlsx or live sheet connection; image cells name attached local files and web addresses are never fetched.

name: Social size presets
notes: Eight reference size presets as batch sizes or per-asset size variations with exact frame dimensions. Layout is a proportional fit, not smart reflow; variations need the current published revision.

name: Marketing batch variations
notes: Rows × sizes produce real locked, editable assets in one edit, so one Undo removes the batch. Batches are filterable and export normally.

name: Asset approval workflow
notes: Status flow Draft, In review, Changes needed, Approved, with timestamps. The store enforces the slot freeze.

name: Asset version history
notes: Compares against named versions and also keeps the last 12 automatic snapshots per asset, restorable with Undo. Images over 256 KB are not kept in snapshots.

name: Bulk asset export
notes: One ZIP with manifest and checksums through the shared delivery pipeline: PNG, JPG or SVG at 1x to 3x, optionally approved only. Limits are 200 assets and 100 MB per archive.

name: Campaign asset folders
notes: Projects sit in local folders, and each asset has an optional campaign that filters and searches the list.

name: Shared brand library
notes: .formabrand.json carries the kit and published templates, with strict validation, review and additive merge. Starter kits and local libraries also work.

name: Template duplication
notes: Duplicates a template as an independent draft with remapped slots, with Undo.

name: Template publishing
notes: Publish gate, revisions and frozen published frames, with published templates included in the package.

name: Brand asset search
notes: Project search covers asset and template names, category, status, size, batch, text slot content and kit values; the Files screen also matches this content. Image contents are not searched.

name: Large document loading
notes: Measured benchmark added and dense pages mount in batches; 20,000 layers first frame ~1.4 s vs ~5.8 s single pass (dev server, Chromium, M3 Max). The whole document is still parsed and kept in memory. See docs/PERFORMANCE-BENCHMARK.md.

name: Progressive page loading
notes: Pages with 3,000+ in-view layers mount root subtrees in ~800-layer batches with a progress indicator; pixels match the single-pass scene. Not applied to one dominant root, masks/blur fallbacks, drafts or non-Design views; later edits re-render in one pass.

name: Viewport culling
notes: Partial: bounded conservative whole-root-subtree culling on the Design/Whiteboard canvas, with opt-out, selected/editing retention, exact immutable source index and measured viewport. Real omitted DOM/defs plus on/off pixels, pan/zoom/resize/Undo/export checks. Uncertain text/effect/media/Boolean/complex-stroke roots stay rendered; root mask runs and unsupported scenes fall back fully. Shared Artwork/model/exports unchanged. See docs/CANVAS-VIEWPORT-CULLING.md.

name: Large layer tree virtualization
notes: Cached iterative hierarchy indexing and a bounded virtualized Layers tree support logical ARIA siblings/depth, keyboard offscreen reveal, selection/filter preservation, drag/reparent, Undo/save and source-bound focus. Actual 20,000-layer flat hidden-layer files keep rendered rows bounded. Whole-canvas deep hierarchy acceptance remains separate. See docs/LAYER-TREE-VIRTUALIZATION.md.

name: Image decode scheduling
notes: Page images decode in a bounded queue when a page opens, two at a time, nearest the view first, up to 256, and stop when the page changes. No speedup is claimed, and WebKit can still decode an image synchronously if it paints first. See docs/PERFORMANCE-BENCHMARK.md.

name: Font loading status
notes: Unreleased source: Shared live task status covers catalog, bundled/Google/cache loading, embedded/imported registration, ready/failure/unavailable/superseded outcomes and retry. Compact unique-family indicator and last40 volatile task details; no invented byte percentage. Async Apply/Replace retain exact invalidatable source context, valid Undo/save and no newer-dialog close. docs/FONT-LOADING-CONTEXT.md.

name: Asset cache management
notes: Storage measures embedded assets, versions, branches, Undo history and cached fonts, and clears Undo history of closed files and cached fonts, keeping imported fonts and fonts inside documents. There is no separate image cache to purge, so embedded assets are only reported.

name: Accessibility contrast audit
notes: Automatic per-text-layer WCAG audit over painter order, with opacity compositing, worst gradient stop, worst text range and a one-Undo lightness fix. Images are not sampled: image, video, blend, partial-overlap, rotated, non-rectangular and theme-canvas backgrounds report "not evaluated". Non-text contrast and text covered from above are not assessed.

name: Missing font audit
notes: v0.2.0-dev.3: reachable authoring/playback path, undo/persistence and validation where applicable. Core/browser/native evidence and limits: docs/VALIDATION-v0.2-prototypes-workspaces.md. Reference acceptance remains separate. Family audit includes character-range font families.

name: Unused style audit
notes: Lists paint, text, effect, stroke and guide styles from the conservative asset index, and removal re-proves each is unreferenced with one Undo. Incomplete scans and installed-library styles are never removable; external library consumers are not visible.

name: Detached instance audit
notes: Detach now records additive, validated detachedFrom; findings cover recorded detaches, deleted mains, orphans and likely legacy matches (name plus exact ordered type tree). Restore keeps the root ID and paint order with one Undo, replaces local edits, and is refused when prototype links, Motion tracks or comments point inside the frame. Legacy copies that were renamed or edited are not found.

name: Duplicate color audit
notes: Indexes fills, strokes, gradient stops, text ranges, variables, paint styles and palette, with exact and ΔE 3 near groups. Merges into a new or existing variable, a style or a literal with one Undo; locked and managed layers are skipped, and paint styles link only single opaque fills. Near comparison caps at the 2,000 most used colors, and token values use the default mode.

name: Token consistency audit
notes: Compares fill, stroke, radius, gap, padding, font size, opacity and stroke width to variables in each layer's effective mode with scopes, plus paint, text and effect style equality proved by scratch application. Finds broken and wrong-kind links; bind, snap and remove-link fixes use one Undo and skip stale rows. Instance copies are not listed, and coverage counts only these fields.

name: Batch rename preview
notes: v0.2.0-dev.5: reachable controls with core/browser validation, undo/persistence where applicable, universal Mac build and native smoke. See docs/VALIDATION-v0.2-controls-workflows.md. Exact Figma reference acceptance remains separate. Batch rename shows every resulting name and validates the complete selection before a single edit.

name: Multi-format export queue
notes: File → Export queue holds snapshot rows in format sets or custom SVG/PNG/JPG, with sequential render, failure isolation, cancel, retry and a ZIP manifest listing what is missing. Session-only, 200 files and 100 MB; PDF stays in Export.

name: Document minimap navigation
notes: View/Actions → Show overview minimap shows current-page schematic bounds, camera viewport, click/drag/keyboard navigation and Fit/F, with camera history and no saved-artwork edit. Cached bounded affine transforms, logical viewport/scaled tracks and permanent source/gesture interruption proofs are tested. Approximate clips, no masks/effect ink or all-pages atlas. See docs/DOCUMENT-MINIMAP.md.

name: Command usage learning
notes: Help → Command usage is opt-in and stores only per-command counts on the device, feeding a Frequently used section in Actions and shortcut tips. Actions that bypass commands, such as arrow nudges and tool keys, are not counted.

name: Custom workspace layouts
notes: View → Workspace layouts saves up to 24 named arrangements of sidebar widths and collapse, left tab, rulers, grid, outlines, minimap and scrollbars, applied live and never touching a document. Forma has no dockable panels, so panels cannot be rearranged; layouts cannot be shared or bound to shortcuts.

name: Side-by-side device preview
notes: View → Side-by-side device preview reflows one Design frame at up to six device or custom sizes through the shared resize derivation, with per-size overflow counts and per-card refusal, and never touches the document. Previews are static images: prototypes do not run, and the 16 MB resize limit applies.

name: Design-to-code export presets
notes: File → Design-to-code export generates HTML/CSS, React, SwiftUI and Compose plus five token formats, with seven built-in presets and saved presets. Output is approximate with listed reductions: images and vectors are placeholders, and gradients, effects and mixed text are reduced. Generated native code is not compiled and output is not visually compared.

name: Cross-tool color palette exchange
notes: Resources → palette exchange reads and writes .ase, .aco, .gpl, .sketchpalette, .swatches, design tokens JSON, CSS and hex lists, and also reads Tailwind-shaped JSON, with bounded validation and one-Undo import. Solid opaque colors only; CMYK and LAB convert without a profile. Tested with its own writers and one hand-built .ase, not files from the real applications.

name: Reusable personal starter kits
notes: Bounded private device-local full project starter kits support named save, lazy preview, independent creation/export, removal Undo and persistence without community publishing or cloud sync. Strict envelopes, transactional byte/count limits and source-bound abort protect existing data. See docs/LOCAL-TEMPLATE-GALLERY.md.

name: One-click bug report bundle
notes: Help → Create bug report bundle saves a local ZIP of counts, safe settings and redacted errors, and a canary test proves no document strings reach it. Including the document is an unchecked per-bundle opt-in that resets after each save and adds a separately named file. Forma never transmits it; toast messages are not captured, and native save was not exercised.

name: Local automation API
notes: mcp/automation.ts is a source-checkout JSON CLI using the same transactions, validators and locks as MCP. No installed binary, stable API promise or in-app scripting host.

name: Scriptable batch transforms
notes: Object → Batch transforms runs validated declarative JSON scripts (scope, filters, seven operations) with a private-copy preview and one Undo; they can be saved or exported. Nothing is evaluated, there are no conditionals or variables, and locked or managed layers are skipped. JavaScript automation stays in Local plugins.

name: Privacy dashboard
notes: Help → Privacy dashboard shows live local stores, counts records without reading values, reads the enforced connect-src policy and observed hosts, and clears selected stores after confirmation. It discloses the Google Fonts request, which cannot be turned off, and plugin requests to origins you grant per run. Projects, fonts and plugins are managed from their own screens.

name: Live editor document synchronization
notes: The Mac shell reloads a clean window within about 1-4 s after a saved-file change, honoring the MCP lock, as one Undo step that keeps surviving selection. Dirty windows keep their edits and Save still asks; sync is one way, so MCP cannot see unsaved state. docs/MCP-LIVE-CONTEXT.md.

name: Live editor selection access
notes: read_live_editor returns page, selection and viewport from an opt-in per-window sidecar beside the saved project, resolved against the saved file. Read-only, shows the latest publication, needs a saved file and an open window. The tool is listed by the standalone bundle; its live path was not exercised through the bundle.

name: Live editor screenshot capture
notes: read_live_screenshot returns an actual WKWebView snapshot of the whole window, including panels, up to 1,600 px wide. Republished on change rather than on demand; a minimized window or background tab has none.

name: MCP raster artwork export
notes: export_live_artwork_png returns the selection or page rendered by the open editor at 1×, longest side 4,096 px. There is no headless raster export, because the server has no renderer.

name: MCP image asset import
notes: Imports static PNG of every color type, depth and interlace, baseline or progressive JPEG, one-frame GIF and static lossy, lossless or extended WebP, up to 20 MB and 16 million pixels. Revision-checked with Undo. Animation refuses, and paths and URLs are never read. The published download needs the rebuild you own.

name: MCP installed-font query
notes: list_installed_fonts reads name tables in fixed OS font folders, returns no paths or bytes, and can compare with document fonts. macOS on-demand and .dfont fonts are not listed; runtime tested on macOS only and not cross-checked against NSFontManager's list.

name: Coordinate native editor and MCP writers
notes: v0.2.0-dev.6: reachable workflow with appropriate core/browser/native checks and persistence/undo where applicable. See docs/VALIDATION-v0.2-grid-files-windows.md. Exact Figma reference acceptance remains separate. Native and MCP writers share the exclusive project lock; native saves compare disk SHA-256 and require an explicit choice after external changes. Live renderer synchronization and non-cooperating application locking remain outside this behavior. See docs/MAC-WINDOWS.md and mcp/README.md.

name: Durable MCP undo history
notes: Last 20 transactions, up to 250 MB, persist across restarts in a private hidden folder beside the project, with read_undo_history and clear_undo_history. Undo is refused after any external change; no Redo; the folder keeps older content until cleared. docs/MCP-LOCAL-AUTOMATION.md.
